_comment: DISCOVERY POOL: names of companies NOT yet on the watchlist. discover.mjs derives slug variants from them, probes the public ATS APIs, and promotes the ones with a live board and plausible reqs. Add names freely: a name that answers on no API costs a handful of failed requests. Do NOT put agencies, consultancies or body shops here: discover.mjs skips names matching INTERMEDIARY.names anyway, so probing them is pure waste.
_why: The poller only sees companies it already knows. Discovery finds the ones never listed, and it is cumulative: every promoted board stays watched, every failed slug is memoised in .tried.json. Names come from the init interview, the bootstrap workflow, the web-search workflow (it PROPOSES names, it never writes them here), and by hand.
